Bid Summary.value: Dallas Independent School District (Dallas ISD) is soliciting proposals for student and staff computing devices under RFP JA-207652. The solicitation includes requirements for Minority/Women Business Enterprise (M/WBE) prime self-performance up to 50% of the M/WBE goal, submission of Form 1295 with the response, and compliance with criminal background checks and identification badging for vendor personnel. Contracts resulting from this RFP require formal approval by the District's Board of Trustees and issuance of a purchase order before any goods or services are delivered. Vendors must adhere to the PDF submission format unless responding electronically, and any deviations from the solicitation terms must be clearly noted in the proposal.

Product Specification.value: Tier 1 Staff Basic Laptop: Intel i5 CPU 14th Gen or equivalent, 13" display, 16GB DDR5 RAM, 512GB NVMe SSD, Windows 11 or Mac OS, 3-year warranty. Tier 2 Staff Professional Desktop: Intel i7 Processor 14th Gen or equivalent, 23.8" Touch Screen, 32GB DDR5 RAM, 1TB NVMe SSD, Windows 11 Pro or Mac OS. Tier 2 Large Student Chromebook Laptop: Intel Celeron N100 or equivalent, 14" Non-Touch, 8GB DDR5, 128GB eMMC, Chrome OS, 1-year warranty.
